## What this changes

A new HIP, an edit to an existing HIP, or a repository change.

## HIP number and title

## Checklist

- [ ] One HIP per pull request.
- [ ] Front matter is complete and `scripts/check-frontmatter.sh` passes.
- [ ] `scripts/check-sections.sh` passes and the required sections are in order.
- [ ] `scripts/check-index.sh` passes and the README index row matches the front matter.
- [ ] `scripts/check-links.sh` passes and relative links resolve.
- [ ] Status is honest: nothing is described as audited or deployed unless it is.
- [ ] No invented numbers. Examples are labelled as examples.
- [ ] No em dashes.
- [ ] Open questions are listed, not hidden.
